title: 第三章 搬血极境第四章 六道轮回之主求书单收藏
slug: 自完美世界开始第2369章唐昊
content_zh:
搞不清楚石昊是抱着什么心态到来的。短暂的沉默后，林阳主动开口道：“多谢。”
石昊微微摇头后，笑着道：“不用谢我，这是你抓住了这一次机会蜕变了己身，否则遗留的神能最多三天就会完全消散。”
他本来是心血来潮才回来看看，没想到会看到林阳在他蜕变后遗留的废血中磨练己身。这对尊者境界的他来说是废血，但对常人来说就是一场脱胎换骨的机缘。
“对你来说只是一件小事不值得在意，但说到底我还是承了你的情。”林阳继续道：“我家乡有句话，‘滴水之恩，当涌泉相报’等日后有机会我一定会还了这次恩情。”
林阳对于自己系统是什么等级，能不能追上石昊这种两三百年成至尊的变态没什么准确的概念，但是想要报答石昊对他来说却是不难。
荒天帝一生大道独行，一剑独断万古。但一生的几个遗憾林阳都是清楚的，这是他的优势。
“滴水之恩当涌泉相报吗？那我期待着，记住，我叫……荒。”
石昊哈哈一笑。他伸指向前一点，便有一道神光飞进林阳体内。他没有报出自己的真名，忌惮上界的敌对势力派出真神来追杀他，刚涅盘结束还处在天地大道完善中，无法动用宝术。
神光速度极快，林阳还没反应过来就感觉大脑一阵，被神光击中。
神光中是一枚枚的闪烁着雷光的符文，林阳将意念集中在符文上，感觉到这是一种与雷电相关的符文。
“狻猊宝术，修成后可掌握天下间一切雷霆。”石昊开口解释道。这是他洞天境界时仗之横行的强横宝术，对现在的他来说并不是什么重要的东西。
“大恩不言谢！”
闻言，林阳心中一喜，搬血境可以靠水磨的功夫修成。但是狻猊宝术这种威力的宝术，哪怕放在上界也不是可以轻易得到的。石昊简直是他的送宝童子，不对，是老爷爷。又给了他修为又给了杀伐术，这样等再次穿越的时候至少又多了一项底牌。
知道短时间内无法修炼成狻猊宝术，林阳就想试一试自己肉身力量达到了多少斤。石昊已经提前离开了，对他来说现在的林阳不值得他过多的留意，今晚再赠予林阳一门宝术也只是兴之所至，没渴望过回报。
跃跃欲试的林阳也顾不得去休息，一路来到了朱村中央，那里摆放着一排青铜鼎，是村里人测试力量专用的。
没有去管前面几个千斤重量的，他直接来到了靠后的万斤巨鼎面前。
青铜鼎上有岁月斑驳的痕迹，明显是久远之前打造出的。
“两万斤！起！”
林阳单臂一晃，仅用了一只手就将巨鼎高高举起毫不费力。两万斤已经是搬血境中期的力道了，而林阳毫不费力就做到。
将手中青铜鼎放在原地后，林阳又越过几个巨鼎，来到最后的巨鼎前。

这是一尊五万斤的青铜鼎，除了体积是最大之外，样式和前面的小鼎没有区别。
“起！”
这一尊五万斤青铜鼎比之两万斤的要重了一倍多，但是林阳感觉自身没有多费力，照样轻松的给举了起来。
五万斤代表着搬血境大成的力道，而林阳目前的力量要远远将其超越，已经没有更重的青铜鼎让他测量力气了。
“想要知道力道有多大，必须要找到专用的神铁……”林阳微微一顿，接着眼神明亮起来，他看着前几个万斤巨鼎。
“两三个摞在一起，重量总算够了吧？”边说边做，他就将四万斤巨鼎压在了最大的青铜鼎上，尝试举起。
这一次，远没有前两次的轻松，明显能感觉到吃力，但还是举起来了！这说明九万斤都不是他的极限。再次往上压了一尊三万斤的鼎，这一次，举得非常艰难，林阳可以感觉到自己的手臂都在发抖。
脚下的大地，所立足之处寸寸龟裂，下沉塌陷。
“单臂超过十万斤，这是搬血极境啊！”
将巨鼎复归原位后，林阳被自己的巨力所震惊了。具体来说他的力量超过了十二万斤，也就是能将六十吨的重物举起。若是要打人，全力一击可能会造成劣质血浆电影中那样的效果。
不到一天的时间，他的力量就暴增一百五十多倍。要是让朱村众人知道了必定会羡慕的流口水，没人能想到一个被认为的废地会造就这样一个奇迹。
第二天，林阳一如既往的继续着锻炼，他发现修成搬血极境后自身对于力量的细微控制下降许多，虽然之前也没有能控制的多好，但也要超过现在。他没有着急修炼狻猊宝术，哪怕从前没接触过宝术，林阳也知道这并非一时片刻就能修成的东西。
他预计目标是等下一次的穿越来临前，可以初步了解狻猊宝术就可以，没有奢望更多。
日子一天天过去，自从一年前就传出消息的勇士选拔大赛开始了，朱村渴望成名的年轻一代都提前出发参加比赛，而石昊也跟着队伍想要去见识见识，他自登临上界后还没有远离过朱村。
林阳没有跟着离开，他知道再过几日朱村也不负宁静。仙殿那位年轻大人追杀一位拥有隐秘的银发女子，此女身上的机缘让上界的几位天骄‘初代’都会一一现身雷州爆发尊者级数的大战。
“火腾金一、闪电子、甄古、月婵、魔女、仙殿的……”
想到此次会现身的上界天骄，林阳的眼神渐渐变得深邃，哪怕此刻和对方有着天地般的差距，他也没有放在心上。超越对方只是迟早的事情，林阳有着自信。哪怕他还未成洞天境，而那几位天骄早就在尊者境中纵横无敌。
“明天就可以穿越了，真是期待啊。”
要不是此地即将风云汇聚，甚至会有真神出手，林阳并不想一到时间就穿越离开，毕竟系统没有强制他，选择权一直都在他自己手里。
“也不知道会穿越到哪一个世界，如果是低等武侠世界……那画面简直太美。”

林阳想到自己一拳把所谓的天下第一高手打成小饼饼，忍不住摇了摇头，那样会得不到历练点的，这一个月都没触发过任务，他已经对通过任务获得历练点不抱多大的期望了。
……

content_en:
It's unclear what mentality Shi Hao came with. After a brief silence, Lin Yang took the initiative and said, "Thank you."
Shi Hao shook his head slightly and said with a smile: "No need to thank me, it's because you seized this opportunity to transform yourself, otherwise the remaining divine energy will completely dissipate in three days at most."
He came back to visit on a whim, but he didn't expect to see Lin Yang training himself in the waste blood left after his transformation. For him in the realm of the Venerable, this is a waste of blood, but for ordinary people, it is an opportunity to be reborn.
"It's just a small thing for you and not worth caring about, but in the final analysis I still accept your love." Lin Yang continued: "There is a saying in my hometown, 'a drop of water should be repaid by a spring.' I will definitely repay this kindness when I have the opportunity in the future."
Lin Yang didn't have an accurate idea of what level his system was and whether he could catch up with a pervert like Shi Hao who became supreme in two to three hundred years, but it was not difficult for him to repay Shi Hao.
Emperor Huang Tian walked alone in his life, and he ruled with one sword for eternity. But Lin Yang is aware of several regrets in his life, and this is his advantage.
"Should the kindness of a drop of water be repaid by a spring of water? Then I look forward to it. Remember, my name is... Huang."
Shi Hao laughed. He stretched his finger forward, and a ray of divine light flew into Lin Yang's body. He did not tell his true name, fearing that the hostile forces in the upper world would send true gods to hunt him down. He had just finished Nirvana and was still in the process of perfecting the Great Way of Heaven and Earth, unable to use precious magic.
The divine light was extremely fast. Before Lin Yang could react, he felt his brain was hit by the divine light.
In the divine light were runes that shone with thunder. Lin Yang focused his thoughts on the runes and felt that they were runes related to thunder and lightning.
"The Suanni Treasure Technique, after being mastered, can control all the thunder in the world." Shi Hao explained. This was a powerful treasure technique that he used rampantly when he was in the Cave Heaven Realm. It was not something important to him now.
"Thank you for your kindness!"
Hearing this, Lin Yang felt happy. The blood-moving realm could be achieved by using water mill skills. But a powerful treasure like the Suanni Treasure Technique cannot be easily obtained even if it is placed in the upper realm. Shi Hao was simply his treasure-delivery boy, no, he was the old man. He was given cultivation and killing techniques, so that he would have at least one more trump card when he traveled through time again.
Knowing that he would not be able to master the Suani Treasure Technique in a short period of time, Lin Yang wanted to test how many kilograms of physical strength he had reached. Shi Hao had already left early. For him, Lin Yang was not worthy of his attention. Giving Lin Yang a magic skill tonight was just out of curiosity and he had no desire for anything in return.
Lin Yang, who was eager to try, didn't bother to rest, and went all the way to the center of Zhu Village, where there was a row of bronze tripods, which were used exclusively by the villagers to test their strength.
Ignoring the several thousand-jin cauldrons in front, he came directly to the ten-thousand-jin giant cauldron at the back.
There are mottled traces of time on the bronze tripod, which was obviously made a long time ago.
"Twenty thousand catties! Get up!"
Lin Yang swung one arm and lifted the giant cauldron high effortlessly with only one hand. Twenty thousand kilograms is already the strength of the mid-level Blood Moving Realm, and Lin Yang could do it effortlessly.
After placing the bronze cauldron in his hand on the spot, Lin Yang passed several giant cauldrons and came to the last giant cauldron.
This is a 50,000-jin bronze tripod. Apart from being the largest in size, its style is no different from the previous small tripod.
"Get up!"
This 50,000-jin bronze tripod was more than twice as heavy as the 20,000-jin bronze tripod, but Lin Yang felt that he didn't have to put in much effort and could still lift it easily.
Fifty thousand kilograms represents the strength of the blood-moving realm, and Lin Yang's current strength far exceeds it. There is no heavier bronze tripod for him to measure his strength.
"If you want to know how powerful it is, you must find a special divine iron..." Lin Yang paused for a moment, then his eyes brightened, and he looked at the first few giant cauldrons weighing ten thousand kilograms.
"Two or three pilesTogether, the weight is finally enough, right? "While talking, he pressed the 40,000-jin giant cauldron on the largest bronze cauldron and tried to lift it.
This time, it was far less relaxed than the previous two times. It was obviously difficult, but I still lifted it! This shows that 90,000 pounds is not his limit. He pressed the 30,000-jin cauldron upward again. This time, it was very difficult to lift it. Lin Yang could feel his arms shaking.
The ground beneath his feet was cracked and sinking.
"A single arm weighs more than 100,000 pounds, this is the ultimate level of blood-moving! "
After returning the giant cauldron to its original position, Lin Yang was shocked by his own strength. Specifically, his strength exceeds 120,000 kilograms, which means he can lift sixty tons of weight. If you were to hit someone, a full blow might have the same effect as in a bad plasma movie.
In less than a day, his strength increased by more than 150 times. If everyone in Zhu Village knew about it, they would definitely drool with envy. No one could have imagined that such a miracle could be created in a supposedly wasteland.
The next day, Lin Yang continued to exercise as usual. He found that after cultivating the extreme realm of moving blood, his subtle control of power dropped a lot. Although he was not able to control it as well as before, it was still better than now. He was not in a hurry to practice the Suanni Treasure Technique. Even if he had never been exposed to the Suanni Treasure Technique before, Lin Yang knew that it was not something that could be mastered in a moment.
He estimated that his goal was to have a preliminary understanding of the Suani Treasure Technique before his next time travel, and he did not expect anything more.
Days passed, and the Warrior Selection Competition that had been announced a year ago had begun. The young generation in Zhu Village who were eager to become famous all set out early to participate in the competition, and Shi Hao also followed the team to see more. He has not been far away from Zhu Village since he climbed to the upper world.
Lin Yang did not leave. He knew that in a few days Zhucun would not lose its tranquility. The young master in the Immortal Palace was chasing a silver-haired woman with a secret. The opportunity given to this woman caused several geniuses from the upper world to show up one by one in Leizhou, and a battle broke out at the level of the Lord.
"Huoteng Jinyi, Lightning Child, Zhengu, Yuechan, Witch, Immortal Palace's..."
Thinking of the genius from the upper world who would appear this time, Lin Yang's eyes gradually became profound. Even though there was a world-wide gap between him and him at this moment, he didn't take it to heart. It was only a matter of time before he surpassed the opponent. Lin Yang was confident. Even though he has not yet reached the Cave Heaven Realm, those geniuses have already become invincible in the Venerable Realm.
“I can travel through time tomorrow, I’m really looking forward to it. "
If it weren't for the storm that was about to gather here, and even the true god would take action, Lin Yang didn't want to time travel and leave as soon as the time came. After all, the system did not force him, and the choice was always in his own hands.
"I don't know which world I will travel to. If it is a low-level martial arts world... the picture is simply too beautiful. "
Lin Yang thought about beating the so-called best master in the world into a small cake with one punch, and couldn't help but shook his head. That would not get experience points. He had not triggered a mission in the past month, and he no longer had much expectations for gaining experience points through missions.
…
